text: Cycling is a form of exercise which involves the act of pedaling a bicycle over flat terrain or uphill. This activity helps to strengthen the legs, lower back, and core muscles. The bicycle is typically equipped with four tires, each having a unique tread pattern that provides traction on different types of surfaces. Additionally, disc brakes are commonly used on modern bicycles. These brakes allow the rider to control the brakes by pushing down on the left pedal. Tires can be found in various styles, including knobby, soft, and hard compounds, each suited for specific riding conditions.
